tei:titleStmt.tei:title: רִבּוֹן הָעוֹלָמִים אַתָּה צִוִּיתָֽנוּ לְהַקְרִיב
Ribon ha-Olamim atah tsivitanu l'haqriv — let the offering of our lips substitute for animal sacrifice

tei:div.tei:head: Ribon ha-Olamim atah tsivitanu l'haqriv — let the offering of our lips substitute for animal sacrifice

tei:lg.tei:l: Master of the Worlds,
you commanded us to bring the Perpetual Offering at its appointed time;
and have the Kohanim perform their service,
and the Leviïm [sing and play music] on the platform,
and the Yisraëlim [attend] at their Ma’amad.
And now, because of our sins,
the Holy Temple is destroyed,
and the Perpetual Offering discontinued;
we have neither a Kohen at his service,
nor a Levi on his platform,
nor a Yisraëli at his Ma’amad.
However, you declared:
“Let [the offering of] our lips replace bull [sacrifices].” (Hosea 14:3)
Therefore may it be your will
YHVH our elo’ah, and elo’ah of our ancestors,
that the prayer of our lips be considered
and accepted and regarded favorably before you,
as if we had offered the Perpetual Offering at its appointed time,
and stood in attendance at its service,
as we said,
“Let [the offering of] our lips replace bull [sacrifices]” (Hosea 14:3)
